arxiv-2209-06052.title: Polytropic fits of modern and unified equations of state
arxiv-2209-06052.creator: Lami Suleiman ID, Morgane Fortin ID, Constança Providência ID, Julian Leszek Zdunik ID
arxiv-2209-06052.description: Abstract Background Equations of state for a cold neutron star’s interior are presented in three-column tables that relate the baryonic density, the energy density, and the pressure. A few analytical expressions for those tables have been established these past two decades, as a convenient way to present a large number of nuclear models for neutron-star matter.

arxiv-2301-13257.title: Condition Numbers of Hessenberg Companion Matrices Thanks: Research of Vander Meulen was supported in part by NSERC Discovery Grant 2022-05137. Thanks: Research of Van Tuyl was supported in part by NSERC Discovery Grant 2019-05412 Thanks: Research of Voskamp was supported in part by NSERC USRA 50427
arxiv-2301-13257.creator: Michael Cox, Kevin N. Vander Meulen, Adam Van Tuyl, Joseph Voskamp
arxiv-2301-13257.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michael Cox, Kevin N. Vander Meulen, Adam Van Tuyl, Joseph Voskamp. The Fiedler matrices are a large class of companion matrices that include the well-known Frobenius companion matrix. The Fiedler matrices are part of a larger class of companion matrices that can be characterized with a Hessenberg form. In this paper, we demonstrate that the Hessenberg form of the Fiedler companion matrices provides a straight-forward way to compare the condition numbers of these matrices.

arxiv-2410-02131.title: Boosting Masked ECG-Text Auto-Encoders as Discriminative Learners
arxiv-2410-02131.creator: Hung Manh Pham, Aaqib Saeed, Dong Ma
arxiv-2410-02131.description: Abstract The accurate interpretation of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is pivotal for diagnosing cardiovascular diseases. Integrating ECG signals with accompanying textual reports further holds immense potential to enhance clinical diagnostics by combining physiological data and qualitative insights. However, this integration faces significant challenges due to inherent modality disparities and the scarcity of labeled data for robust cross-modal learning.

pmc-13528356.title: Active site engineering of recombinant human paraoxonase 1 for enhancing its catalytic efficiency against V-type nerve agent analog- Demeton S
pmc-13528356.creator: Manik Goel, Pulkita Pandey, Subhashree Sahu, Rinkoo Devi Gupta
pmc-13528356.description: Human Paraoxonase 1 (HuPON1) is a calcium-dependent serum enzyme with broad substrate specificity and therapeutic potential for detoxifying the organophosphates, including nerve agents. The V-type nerve agents are the most toxic synthetic organophosphates, with high lethality and environmental persistence, necessitating the development of an efficient catalytic bioscavenger for their detoxification.

pmc-13565478.title: Substrate Recognition Analysis in an Ethyl Carbamate-Hydrolyzing Esterase and Semi-Rational Baijiu Flavor Preservation
pmc-13565478.creator: Binchen Wang, Naihui Dong, Siyu Xue, Yuxuanwen Zhao, Chaofan Ji, Beiwei Zhu, Sufang Zhang
pmc-13565478.description: Ethyl carbamate (EC) is a widely recognized carcinogen present in fermented foods, and enzymatic degradation is a safe and effective strategy for its reduction. An EC-degrading esterase derived from Acinetobacter calcoaceticus (AcECH) was previously identified. However, volatile ester compounds in Chinese Baijiu compete with EC for enzyme binding, thereby affecting degradation efficiency and flavor quality.

pmc-13661888.title: Bioactive adrenomedullin dynamics and microcirculatory changes in a porcine model of hemorrhagic shock
pmc-13661888.creator: Carolin Vekla, Oliver Hartmann, Sebastian O Decker, Maik von der Forst, Florian Uhle, Alexander Studier-Fischer, Berkin Özdemir, Felix Nickel, Stephan Katzenschlager, Frank Weilbacher, Thorsten Brenner, Erik Popp, Markus A Weigand, Karsten Schmidt, Maximilian Dietrich, Daniel Gruneberg
pmc-13661888.description: BackgroundHemorrhagic shock is a leading cause of preventable trauma death, marked by impaired oxygen delivery and endothelial dysfunction. Bioactive adrenomedullin (bio-ADM) regulates endothelial barrier integrity, but its dynamics during hemorrhagic shock and resuscitation remain unclear. This secondary analysis of a porcine hemorrhagic shock model investigated bio-ADM and its association with macro- and microcirculatory parameters during resuscitation.
